question: Which of the following is NOT an elected functionary?
solution:
The correct answer is:** __Executive Officer - Municipal Board__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A** functionary**** **is someone who fills a specific role in a political party or some other organization.
 
• The** ****State Government **shall appoint the **Chairman of the Board of every municipality **mentioned in the first Schedule of the **Constitution of municipal board.**
 
• This functionary elected include:
 
 
• ​Chairman- Municipal corporation
 
• Chairman- District Board
 
• Chairman- Municipal Board
 
 
 
• ​All of the above can be appointed by state government but not the executive officer as it is head of organisation so must not functionary elected.
 
• They are appointed by the state government from the Indian Administrative Service and are responsible for heading the administrative staff of the municipal corporation, implementing the decisions, and preparing its annual budget.
 
• The 74th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992 strengthened existing urban local bodies as institutions of self-governance by reorganising them into three categories—Municipal Corporations/Mahanagar Palika, Municipal Councils/Nagar Palika, Nagar Panchayat/Notified Area Council.
 
• The Act provided for the constitution of such bodies through direct elections of representatives.
